name: rapifix
description: RAPIFIX - Sistema de Gestión para Taller Automotriz

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run functions:build && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run functions:build && firebase deploy --only functions
